chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Musa, from Ghiyas, from Is-haq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Allah disliked for me six characteristics, then I disliked them for the successors from my offspring and their followers after me: obscenity during fasting.'
ai.seo_question: What are the six characteristics disliked by Allah for the Prophet and his successors, particularly regarding fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the spiritual continuity between the Prophet and the Imams by extending divine aversion to 'rafath' (obscenity or vocalizing sexual matters) to the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers. It underscores that the etiquette of fasting transcends mere physical abstinence from food, requiring purity of speech and mind, a principle deeply rooted in Shia jurisprudence regarding the sanctity of the fast.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Musa, from Giyas, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said; ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Disliked six characteristics for me<sup>saww</sup>, then I<sup>saww</sup> disliked these for the successors<sup>asws</sup> from my<sup>saww</sup> sons<sup>asws</sup>, and their<sup>asws</sup> followers from after me<sup>saww</sup>, (one of these being) obscenities during the Fasting’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Musa from Ghiyath from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘Allah dislikes the existence of six things with me. I dislike such things to exist in the executors of the will in my descendants and their followers after me. One such matter is carnal relations during fasting.’”
